title: Ironing out the wrinkles - Nature Energy
gist: A Kyoto University News & Views commentary on a companion paper describes a surface reconstruction and halide homogenization strategy that fixes surface wrinkling and halide disorder in bromide-rich ultrawide-bandgap perovskites, enabling a certified 29.3% efficiency in all-perovskite triple-junction solar cells.

insights.claim: Ultrawide-bandgap perovskites are a required subcell material for all-perovskite triple-junction solar cells, but their necessarily high bromide content causes surface wrinkling and halide disorder that limits device performance.
insights.speaker: Tomoya Nakamura, Minh Anh Truong and Atsushi Wakamiya
insights.so_what: Identifies the specific materials-chemistry bottleneck (bromide-driven surface wrinkling) that has been capping triple-junction perovskite efficiency — the problem any competing lab or company must also solve.
insights.quote: Ultrawide-bandgap perovskites are essential for all-perovskite triple-junction solar cells, yet their high bromide content causes surface wrinkling and halide disorder, limiting the performance.

insights.claim: A surface reconstruction and halide homogenization strategy now enables a certified efficiency of 29.3% in all-perovskite triple-junction solar devices, addressing the wrinkling/disorder problem described above.
insights.speaker: Tomoya Nakamura, Minh Anh Truong and Atsushi Wakamiya
insights.so_what: A certified (third-party-verified, not just lab-claimed) 29.3% efficiency is a hard, comparable benchmark against silicon and other tandem/triple-junction PV technologies for solar investors tracking the efficiency frontier.
insights.quote: A surface reconstruction and halide homogenization strategy now enables a certified efficiency of 29.3% in all-perovskite triple-junction devices.

insights.claim: Co-author Atsushi Wakamiya is co-founder and chief advisor for science and technology at EneCoat Technologies Co. Ltd, a perovskite-related company, creating a direct academic-to-commercial pipeline around this research.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: A named commercial entity (EneCoat Technologies) with a co-founder on this paper is a direct lead for investors wanting exposure to perovskite triple-junction PV IP, though the competing-interest disclosure also warrants independent verification of claims.
insights.quote: A.W. is co-founder and chief advisor (science and technology) of EneCoat Technologies Co. Ltd.

insights.claim: This commentary accompanies and interprets a separate primary research paper (referenced as Zhang et al., published concurrently in Nature Energy) reporting the actual surface reconstruction and halide homogenization results.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Investors should read this alongside the underlying primary paper (the Zhang et al. crystallization-control study) rather than treat this short commentary as the full technical source.
insights.quote: Zhang, Y. et al. Nat. Energy https://doi.org/10.1038/s41560-026-02135-1 (2026).
